      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned on creation as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' - the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:

              description: Derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.

            pets:

The build is green. 

I implemented `membershipTier` with minimal structural impact — two files, each edited in a small, cohesive spot:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipTier` read-only string property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.
2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping` expression on the already-abstract `toOwnerDto` method (CC 1, negligible surrounding complexity), matching the existing `displayName`/`membershipNumber` style:

   `SILVER` when `namesakeCount == 0` and a non-empty email is present, otherwise `BRONZE`.

I deliberately avoided adding a derived getter to the large `Owner` entity class (high `WMC_other`), keeping the change confined to the mapper's single-expression convention. Both new acceptance tests and the full suite pass.
